## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: SPY (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +3.29%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: -12.69% | 1M: -14.14%) BELOW TREND point to risk-friendly internals, but multiple ratios are neutral → overall NEUTRAL.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -12.69% | 1M: -14.14%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND. Credit/flows supportive: HYG (1W: +0.70% | 1M: +1.64%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.61% | 1M: +1.38%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND, but broader ratio set is neutral.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-supportive: TLT (1W: +0.12% | 1M: +0.15%) → flat | ABOVE TREND while HYG/LQD above trend signal easier credit conditions; overall financial conditions unchanged/neutral.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +6.46% | 1M: +5.77%) ABOVE TREND. Financials/cyclicals strong: Financials/XLF (1W: +4.75% | 1M: +9.44%) ABOVE TREND; Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -0.05%) BELOW TREND. Style: Growth/Tech showing strength with cyclical participation.

**5. US vs Global?**
US strong: SPY (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +3.29%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND. EM/China participation: EEM (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +7.23%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +2.56% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND — global risk-on breadth present.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation healthy: SOXX (1W: +14.31% | 1M: +19.20%) ABOVE TREND, IBIT (1W: +5.24% | 1M: +4.11%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +4.59% | 1M: +1.87%) ABOVE TREND. VXX plunge reduces tail hedging demand.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Industrial metals leading: CPER (1W: +7.26% | 1M: +3.43%) ABOVE TREND. Gold/silver recovering: GLD (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -6.75%) RECOVERY, SLV (1W: +3.31% | 1M: -10.72%) RECOVERY — risk-on but with safe‑haven short-term bounces.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy soft: XLE (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -0.05%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -10.24% | 1M: +1.70%) CORRECTION show sector-specific pressure; nat gas weak: UNG (1W: -6.07% | 1M: -18.10%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad participation — SPY, QQQ, IWM, XLK all ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: Commodities/energy show 1W vs 1M mismatches (USO, BNO CORRECTION; GLD, SLV RECOVERY) — monitor for regime drift.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor growth and cyclicals that are above trend (XLK, QQQ, XLF); reduce exposure to weak energy beta and natural gas (XLE, UNG) while monitoring commodity divergences and any reversal in volatility (VXX).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology XLK (1W: +6.46% | 1M: +5.77%) ABOVE TREND and Semis/SOXX (1W: +14.31% | 1M: +19.20%) ABOVE TREND if momentum holds. BEARISH: Energy XLE (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -0.05%) BELOW TREND and NatGas UNG (1W: -6.07% | 1M: -18.10%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals CPER (1W: +7.26% | 1M: +3.43%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Oil crude proxies USO (1W: -7.54% | 1M: +8.51%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -10.24% | 1M: +1.70%) CORRECTION — watch for further weakness.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD 0.80 (credit health), XLK/XLF 2.0 (growth vs value pivot), SPY technical band (short-term support region based on recent pullbacks).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, but mixed ratio signals keep the regime neutral. Tech and cyclicals showing strength (XLK, QQQ, XLF); energy and commodity divergences (USO/BNO, UNG) are the main risk to monitor.
